id.description: The mod's id: its folder under mods\ and the [mod_<id>] section its settings are saved in.

name.description: Shown in Settings > Mods (up to 60 characters).

author.description: Shown in Settings > Mods (up to 60 characters).

version.description: Shown in Settings > Mods, and compared on update (up to 24 characters).

dll.description: The mod's DLL, a file name in the mod's folder.

games.description: The games it is for. An entry with just an id names a game Sim-QVFR already has (ats, ets2, lmu, ace, acc, xplane): the mod's settings show there. An entry with an exe adds a NEW game: the launcher lists it, and the core loads this mod when that exe starts OpenXR. A mod can't take a game Sim-QVFR has (its id or exe), nor another mod's.

id.description: The game's id: its settings folder games\<id>\ and its tab.

name.description: Shown in the launcher's rail and pages.

short.description: Its short name on the rail ("SPC").

exe.description: The process the core recognises: a file name only.

exeFolder.description: exe's folder under steamFolder; empty: steamFolder itself.

steamAppId.description: Its Steam app id, for a launch from outside Steam.

launchArgs.description: The command line that starts it in VR ("-vr").

image.description: How the core offers the game its QVFR views, so the launcher checks the right size. Default doubleWide.

antiCheat.description: The game's anti-cheat processes: while one runs, Sim-QVFR stays off in that launch and only logs.

features.description: The core features the launcher and headset menu offer for it, once the mod supports them.

source.description: Required: an https link to the mod's source code (its repository). Sim-QVFR mods are open source; the link shows in Settings > Mods, and later lets the launcher check for updates.

license.description: Required: the source code's licence, as an SPDX id ("MIT", "Apache-2.0", "GPL-3.0-only").
